title: A big room: an adjective before the place

sections.title: Adjective and place
sections.content: An adjective goes before the noun and never changes. The ending goes on the noun only, which is the last word of the phrase: *a nagy szoba* becomes *a nagy szobában*. The same works with *új* (“new”), *régi* (“old”) and *szép* (“beautiful”). The article follows the first sound of the whole phrase: *az új lakásban*, because *új* begins with a vowel.

items.spanish: A nagy szobában van egy asztal.
items.english: There is a table in the big room.
Anna is in the new flat.
There is no bathroom in the old house.
Dad is in the beautiful garden.

sections.content: The ending goes only on the noun. The adjective stays exactly as it is, and it never takes *-ban* or *-ben*. Check the article by the first word of the phrase, not by the noun: *az új lakásban*, but *a régi lakásban*.
